description:
Save a region as a named structure, or place a saved structure back into the world. This is the official way to keep what the AI built, mass-produce it, or take it to another world.

**Choose saveMode by what the user wants; do not always use the same one:**
- `memory` (default) = temporary storage for this connection. Use it while the AI keeps revising the same build: save a version to keep a way back, and load it if a change goes wrong. It disappears when the game closes and leaves no files on disk.
- `disk` = only when **the user explicitly says to keep it** ("remember this building", "save it so I can use it next time"). It is written as a file into the game world folder and survives closing the game, which really leaves something on the user disk, so do not write it when they did not ask to keep it.

Versioning is **naming**: `castle_v1`, `castle_v2`. The same name overwrites without warning, so change the name before saving a new version. The game has no command to list saved structures, so names are the only record; mc_status lists the ones saved during this connection.
